title: Finite-stage vanishing of a fixed sheaf in affine degree zero
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(p_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, an abelian sheaf $F$ on the small etale site of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $x\in H^0(D_i,F)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. If $p_i^*(x)=0$ in $H^0(X,p_i^{-1}F)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], there exist $j\in I$ and $f:i\to j$ such that $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*(x)=0$ in $H^0(D_j,D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F)$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), degree zero for the single fixed stage sheaf, using 0EYL, 04HR and Sites 09YN (lemma-colimit-sections).

proof.text: Identify x with its global section g using Sheaf.H.equiv₀ and the Gamma-to-terminal-evaluation isomorphism. The degree-zero pullback formula and injectivity of both identifications turn hx into vanishing of the global section pullback at the limit.

Choose the unit-compatible abelian-to-set section comparisons. The global-section composition identity, followed by cancellation of the composition isomorphism, identifies the comparison of the pullback of any section with its direct pullback. At the identity object of Over(op i), take the images of the identity pullback of g and zero. Their limit images agree by hx. The terminal etale object is isomorphic to the affine stage, so it is affine and its structure morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

Apply affine eventual equality detection to these two underlying set sections at the identity object of Over(op i). It supplies k and two arrows into that same object. Their left components are equal since I is a preorder, so OverMorphism.ext identifies the arrows. Translate the transition equality back using the unit-compatible coefficient comparisons and cancel their bijection. The result is vanishing of the original section pulled back along D.map k.hom. The degree-zero formula gives vanishing of the cohomology class. Take j=k.left.unop and f=k.hom.unop.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ degree zero via existing affine eventual equality detection and unit-compatible abelian-to-set comparison (00YV, 03CB, 03CC). No new statements; unit sk-thm-p1 route preserved.
